# VCS source archives and refs

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/vcs.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **curl from the immutable Maven/Temurin image (runtime version recorded by native CI)**. Registered classes: **remote**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/vcs/downloadTag/${AW_REPO}/team/project/v1.0.0`

## Before connecting

- An operator-created remote VCS repository configured for the intended upstream provider.

Authentication: Use a Bearer access/reference token for an identity with read permission on the remote repository. Upstream Git provider credentials are configured by the repository operator and are separate from the caller token.

Fresh client state: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.

## Configure

This remote-only service has no Git-client registry configuration; it exposes an authorized archive/ref REST API.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
```

## Publish

No supported command. VCS repositories are remote-only. Publish commits and tags to the configured upstream Git provider; there is no artifactweave Git push endpoint.

## Install or resolve

Classes: **remote**. Download a tagged source archive from the configured remote VCS provider.

Replace team/project and v1.0.0 with the upstream project and tag. Inspect the archive before extracting it.

```sh
curl --disable --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/vcs/downloadTag/$AW_REPO/team/project/v1.0.0" --output "$AW_WORK/project.tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$AW_WORK/project.tar.gz"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **remote** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Local, virtual and federated VCS classes are not supported.
- This is archive/ref REST access, not git clone, git fetch or git push.
- curl --disable is the first option so a user curlrc cannot inject alternate credentials, URLs or output settings. The pinned image contains Ubuntu curl 8.18.0-1ubuntu2.8.
